item.title: Sunday’s pot roast now costs more than a Thanksgiving feast. Why beef won’t get cheaper for years.

item.title: The biggest biotech deal in nearly three years carries a hefty $41 billion price tag
item.description: French drugmaker Sanofi on Tuesday agreed to pay $41 billion for U.S. biotech Insmed, a hefty price that will help the pharmaceutical giant offset the patent expiration on a key drug.
item.dc:creator: Steve Goldstein
